desc: L9 'O Bruno levanta o escudo.' Low angle in the arena: Bruno slams fists together and a blue hex energy DOME grows up around him. HUD 'CAMPO DE FORÇA'.
L9 'O Davi encosta o dedo.' Side two-shot: Davi walks up to the dome wall, raises one finger and touches it on 'dedo'.
L9 'Ding.' Extreme close-up: fingertip on the dome, white ripple rings spread across the hexes; comic 'DING!' word.

sfx.what: DING (wine glass chime, clear, long tail)

desc: L9 'quarenta hertz.' Tuner big in frame sweeping and locking on '440 Hz · LÁ' on 'hertz' over the rippling dome; Davi's finger still touching.

sfx.what: tuner lock beep (440 Hz tone blip)

desc: L10 'Ele vibra no mesmo ritmo.' Davi close, yellow energy lines running from his finger up the arm; waveform inset: Davi's yellow wave slides into phase with the dome's blue wave ('EM FASE').
L10 'O escudo treme, treme,' wide: the dome wobbles harder and harder, cracks appear on the 2nd 'treme' (punch-in); Bruno inside sweating.
L10 'e quebra igual taça.' Slow-mo: the dome shatters into blue glass shards on 'quebra' (flash + shockwave), Bruno shielding his face; HUD 'IGUAL TAÇA'.
L11 'O Bruno parte pra cima com um' Bruno charges straight at camera, sand kicking up, speed lines.

sfx.what: angry grunt + heavy footsteps on sand

desc: L11 'soco de duas toneladas.' The fist grows huge toward camera; HUD 'SOCO 2 t' slams on 'duas'.
L12 'O Davi nem desvia.' Davi calm, half smile, the giant blurred fist in the foreground; he crouches.
L12 'Ele vibra o chão.' Palm slaps the sand, yellow energy lines, sand ripples spread in rings.

sfx.what: palm slap on sand + low rumble

desc: L12 'Areia molhada, sacudida' textbook cross-section: packed sand grains touching, water in between. Labels 'GRÃO DE AREIA', 'ÁGUA'.
L12 'rápido, vira quase líquido.' Grains shake, separate and float in water; contact lines break; meter SÓLIDO → LÍQUIDO.
L12 'Chama liquefação.' Arena floor turns glossy and wavy like liquid; stamp 'LIQUEFAÇÃO (real)'.
L12 'Acontece de verdade' insert: buildings tilting into liquefied ground, tag 'NIIGATA, JAPÃO · 1964'.
L12 'em terremoto.' Seismograph needle drawing a big zig-zag on paper (plants the autograph gag).
L13 'O Bruno afunda até a' Bruno mid-charge sinks into the liquid sand, slow, shocked.
L13 'cintura.' Bruno stuck waist-deep, measure arrow 'ATÉ A CINTURA'.
L13 'Toda aquela superforça,' Bruno pounding the sand, splashes, not moving; HUD 'FORÇA 2 t · SAIU DO LUGAR: 0 cm'.
L13 'presa igual pé no' Bruno's strained face close, veins, tugging.
L13 'mangue.' Ground level: a crab walks past right by Bruno, stops, looks at him, waves a claw. Bruno stares.
L14 'Ranking: número' the crowd freezes in shock staring at the top-right meter spinning #312→#1 (rays point at it).
L14/L15 'um. Efeito colateral:' Davi stunned → arms up, confetti, gold light; on 'colateral' stamp 'EFEITO COLATERAL' and he starts trembling.

sfx.what: ding-ding win + crowd roar + confetti pop

desc: L15 'ele passou três horas tremendo.' Davi hugging the trophy, all rattling; time-lapse: arena empties, dusk, clock spins '+3 HORAS'.
L15 'Foi dar autógrafo,' a fan holds out a notebook, Davi takes the pen with a shaking hand.
L15 'saiu um terremoto no papel.' Top-down on the page: the autograph turns into a huge seismograph zig-zag on 'terremoto'; chip 'MAGNITUDE 7,8'.
L16 'E tu? Que poder piada' Davi straight to camera, trembling, points at the viewer on 'tu'.
L16 'tu ia transformar em roubado?' Card swap: PIADA (vibrar) → ROUBADO (crown) goes gold on 'roubado'; Davi smug below.
L16 'Comenta aí.' Extreme close-up, Davi winks on 'aí', comment bubble pops. HARD CUT to black at 78.8.
Black tail.
